title: Create Aeronautics: Portable Engine Overdrive
description: Increases Portable Engine capacity by consuming more fuel
body:
Ever built a vehicle and ended up attaching Portable Engines everywhere?

Portable Engine: Overdrive boosts engine capacity, allowing a single engine to do the work of several—balanced by increased fuel consumption.

Because sometimes your car needs more horsepower, not more engine spaghetti.

Why?

Click to reveal

BECAUSE I DON'T WANT TO STICK FIVE ENGINES ON A CUTE LITTLE CAR.

Your vehicles get smaller. Your fuel bills get bigger.
